searches_tried: Local comps.py (pipeline and work versions): 'huon pine slab', 'huon pine', '2 slabs huon pine --min-price 100', 'huon pine board --min-price 150'; Gowans API search '2 slabs huon pine' (sold lots, many dozens of 2 SLABS lots since July 2026). Same-title Gowans lots since July 2026 mostly sold $30-90 hammer, median roughly $55-65, with occasional $100-180 for wide or long boards. No web searches needed: generic Gowans-only commodity and local sales dominate; retail Huon pine is priced per board foot by dealers and not a like-for-like comp. eBay sold would not materially change this.
viewing_check: Measure length, width and thickness of both boards; check whether it is really Huon pine (smell, fine tight grain, pale yellow), look for splits, rot or worm, and check thickness (thicker, wider, clean boards fetch the $100-180 end). Narrow 25-30 cm boards likely sit around $50-90 hammer.
